sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Real-time, multi-user collaboration directly in the browser, providing a unified platform for design, prototyping, and ideation without needing downloads or installations.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Figma is a leading cloud-based design and prototyping tool that enables real-time collaboration. It is widely used for UI/UX design, wireframing, and interactive prototyping. FigJam, an online collaborative whiteboard, is an integral part of the Figma ecosystem, facilitating brainstorming and ideation.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Figma (UI/UX design
prototyping
design systems)
FigJam (online collaborative whiteboarding
brainstorming
diagramming).

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Freemium model with various paid tiers (Starter, Professional, Organization, Enterprise) offering enhanced features, collaboration limits, and administrative controls.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Product designers, UX researchers, software developers, project managers, design agencies, educational institutions, and cross-functional teams of all sizes.
